_doc: Every error the browser-companion path can produce, as <area>.<reason>. The extension, the app and the server all name errors from this list (tests/test_companion.py fails on an uncatalogued code). 'where' = which part raises it. Messages are shown to the user verbatim; 'fix' is the next step.

companion.not_installed.fix: Install it and pair it with this app (Browser companion → Set up), or reload this page if you just installed it.

companion.timeout.message: The browser companion stopped answering before it finished.
companion.timeout.fix: Check for its approval window (it may be behind this one), then try again.

companion.outdated.message: Your browser companion is older than this app.
companion.outdated.fix: Download it again from Browser companion → Set up, replace the folder, and press Reload on chrome://extensions.

request.invalid.message: The app sent the companion a request it doesn’t understand.
request.invalid.fix: Update the companion and reload this page.

request.busy.message: Another companion request is waiting for your approval.
request.busy.fix: Finish or close the open approval window first.

request.denied.message: You chose not to send it. Nothing was sent.

request.expired.message: The approval window was closed or left open too long. Nothing was sent.
request.expired.fix: Try again and approve within 5 minutes.

request.tab_moved.message: The app tab that asked was closed or left the app, so nothing was sent.
request.tab_moved.fix: Keep the app open in that tab while you approve.

request.cross_site.message: This request came from another website, so the app refused it.
request.cross_site.fix: Use the app’s own page. If you see this in the app itself, report it.

permission.deals_off.message: The companion isn’t allowed to see your store tabs yet.
permission.deals_off.fix: Open the companion’s settings and switch on Deals (Chrome will ask to allow the store sites).

permission.moxfield_off.message: The companion isn’t allowed to read Moxfield yet.
permission.moxfield_off.fix: Open the companion’s settings and switch on Moxfield (Chrome will ask to allow moxfield.com).

permission.manapool_missing.message: The companion can’t open Mana Pool pages — its Mana Pool permission was removed.
permission.manapool_missing.fix: Allow manapool.com in the extension’s Chrome site access settings, or remove and re-add the extension.

permission.tcgplayer_cart_off.message: The companion isn’t allowed to read your TCGplayer cart yet.
permission.tcgplayer_cart_off.fix: Open the companion’s settings and switch on TCGplayer cart (Chrome will ask to allow www.tcgplayer.com).

permission.cardkingdom_cart_off.message: The companion isn’t allowed to read your Card Kingdom cart yet.
permission.cardkingdom_cart_off.fix: Open the companion’s settings and switch on Card Kingdom cart (Chrome will ask to allow www.cardkingdom.com).

cart.load_timeout.message: Your cart page didn’t finish loading.
cart.load_timeout.fix: Open your cart on that store yourself, wait until the cards show, then try again.

cart.empty.message: That cart is empty in this browser.
cart.empty.fix: Add cards on the store (signed in to the account you shop with), then try again.

cart.page_changed.message: The companion couldn’t find any cards on your cart page — the store may have changed its page.
cart.page_changed.fix: Report this so the reader can be updated (the scrape-doctor skill has the steps).

cart.row_unreadable.message: Some cart rows couldn’t be read completely.
cart.row_unreadable.fix: Those rows are listed; check them against your cart.

cart.signed_out.message: You’re not signed in to that store in this browser, so this is the browser’s guest cart.
cart.signed_out.fix: Sign in to the store if your cart lives on your account, then try again.

cart.sign_in.message: The store sent the companion to its sign-in page instead of your cart.
cart.sign_in.fix: Sign in to the store in this browser, open your cart once, then try again.

cart.not_scriptable.message: Chrome didn’t let the companion read the store’s cart page.
cart.not_scriptable.fix: Make sure the store’s site loads normally in this browser, then try again.

cart.paste_invalid.message: That isn’t what the cart bookmarklet copies.
cart.paste_invalid.fix: Open your Mana Pool cart, click the bookmarklet, then paste here again.

tabs.none.message: No tabs from the Deals stores are open in this browser.
tabs.none.fix: Open the store product pages you want priced, then read again.

tabs.page_unreadable.message: Some open-tab store pages couldn’t be read.
tabs.page_unreadable.fix: Reload those tabs, wait for the price to show, then read again.

watched.none.message: None of your watched links are open-tab store pages the companion can read.
watched.none.fix: Nothing to do — those stores are read by the app itself.

watched.load_timeout.message: Some watched store pages didn’t finish loading in their background tab.
watched.load_timeout.fix: Open those pages in this browser, wait for the price to show, then read again.

moxfield.bad_url.message: That isn’t a Moxfield deck, collection or binder link.
moxfield.bad_url.fix: Paste a link like https://moxfield.com/decks/AbC123, https://moxfield.com/collection/AbC123 or https://moxfield.com/binders/AbC123.

moxfield.private.message: Moxfield says this is private to its owner.
moxfield.private.fix: Sign in to Moxfield in this browser as the owner, or share it as Unlisted/Public, then try again.

moxfield.not_found.message: Moxfield has no deck at that link.
moxfield.not_found.fix: Check the link — the deck may have been deleted.

moxfield.blocked.message: Moxfield didn’t answer the companion (often its bot check).
moxfield.blocked.fix: Open the deck on moxfield.com in this browser, wait for it to load, then try again.

moxfield.load_timeout.message: The Moxfield page didn’t finish loading.
moxfield.load_timeout.fix: Open the deck on moxfield.com yourself, then try again.

moxfield.changed.message: Moxfield answered with a deck format the companion doesn’t recognise.
moxfield.changed.fix: Export the deck as text on Moxfield and paste it instead, and report this (the scrape-doctor skill has the steps).

deck.empty.message: The deck arrived but had no cards in it.
deck.empty.fix: Check the deck has cards on the deck site, then try again.

permission.orders_off.message: The companion isn’t allowed to read your TCGplayer or Card Kingdom orders yet.
permission.orders_off.fix: Open the companion’s settings and switch on Order history (Chrome will ask to allow store.tcgplayer.com and cardkingdom.com).

orders.sign_in.message: The store sent the companion to its sign-in page instead of your orders.
orders.sign_in.fix: Sign in to that store in this browser, then try again.

orders.none.message: No orders were found on your order history page.
orders.none.fix: On TCGplayer, pick the year to read in “Orders placed in” on the page itself, then try again.

orders.page_changed.message: The store changed its order pages, so the companion couldn’t read them.
orders.page_changed.fix: Nothing was read. Report it so the reader can be updated.

orders.load_timeout.message: The store’s order page took too long to load.
orders.load_timeout.fix: Check you’re online and the store opens in this browser, then try again.

orders.not_scriptable.message: Chrome didn’t let the companion read the store’s order page.
orders.not_scriptable.fix: Check the companion still has access to that site (chrome://extensions → Details → Site access).

orders.row_unreadable.message: Some order lines couldn’t be fully read.
orders.row_unreadable.fix: They’re listed in the approval window; check them against the store’s page.

orders.unverified_line.message: A line isn’t in a format the companion has been checked against (Card Kingdom single cards are not verified yet).
orders.unverified_line.fix: It is recorded with its price but never added to your collection.

orders.not_found.message: Some orders you picked weren’t on your order history pages.
orders.not_found.fix: Read the list again, then pick from it.

orders.too_many_pages.message: Your order history has more pages than the companion reads at once.
orders.too_many_pages.fix: Read the newest orders first; older ones can be read later.

permission.archidekt_off.message: The companion isn’t allowed to read Archidekt yet.
permission.archidekt_off.fix: Open the companion’s settings and switch on Archidekt decks (Chrome will ask to allow archidekt.com).

archidekt.bad_url.message: That isn’t an Archidekt deck link.

archidekt.private.message: Archidekt didn’t show this deck to your browser.
archidekt.private.fix: If it’s your private deck, sign in to Archidekt in this browser, then try again.

archidekt.not_found.message: Archidekt has no deck at that link.
archidekt.not_found.fix: Check the link — the deck may have been deleted.

archidekt.blocked.fix: Open the deck on archidekt.com in this browser, wait for it to load, then try again.

archidekt.load_timeout.message: The Archidekt page didn’t finish loading.
archidekt.load_timeout.fix: Open the deck on archidekt.com yourself, then try again.

archidekt.changed.message: Archidekt’s deck page changed, so the companion couldn’t read it.
archidekt.changed.fix: Nothing was read. Export the deck as text on Archidekt and paste it instead, and report this (the scrape-doctor skill has the steps).

moxfield.signed_out.message: You aren’t signed in to Moxfield in this browser.
moxfield.signed_out.fix: Sign in on moxfield.com in this browser, or use your collection’s or binder’s share link, then try again.

moxfield.collection_empty.message: That Moxfield collection or binder has no cards.
moxfield.collection_empty.fix: Check you picked the right one on Moxfield, then try again.

moxfield.too_large.message: That Moxfield collection is larger than the companion reads at once (60,000 printings).
moxfield.too_large.fix: Import it a binder at a time.

collection.empty.message: Nothing in that read can be imported — every line was a proxy, a digital copy or unidentified.
collection.empty.fix: Check the collection or binder on Moxfield, then try again.

moxfield.collection_changed.message: Moxfield answered with a collection format the companion doesn’t recognise.
moxfield.collection_changed.fix: Nothing was read. Export the collection as CSV on Moxfield instead, and report this (the scrape-doctor skill has the steps).
